items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Oh, Mean Love used to play that together. Charlie Love, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, that's the old Redback book. Uh-huh. Yeah. Do you remember, where did you play this Redback book, the Joplin Rags? When did you use that?
Oh, Mean Love used to play that together. Charlie Love, yeah.
He's still trying to get a band together to play that now.
